title: Classifying Agent Monitoring Evasion Strategies: A Taxonomy from Red-Team Artifacts

original_idea.body:
# Classifying Agent Monitoring Evasion Strategies: A Taxonomy from Red-Team Artifacts

**Problem:** METR produced covert attack trajectories and attack strategy test sets during their Anthropic red-team engagement, but no public taxonomy of monitoring evasion strategies exists for the broader research community.

**Direction:** Survey published red-team reports, CTF writeups, and jailbreak literature to construct a preliminary taxonomy of agent monitoring evasion strategies (e.g., semantic obfuscation, context manipulation, timing attacks). Validate by testing representatives of each category against a small open-source monitor.

**Why it matters:** A shared taxonomy accelerates defensive research — without common language, monitoring improvements cannot be reliably communicated or compared.

**Relevant context:** METR 2026 red-teaming artifacts; AI red-teaming literature.
